messages:
alexa: FYI got ping from Acme about users unable to SSO after overnight maintenance. SCIM provisioning also seeing 400s.

jamal: can you paste the assertion error?

alexa: from auth-proxy: 'signature verification failed: rsa_padding_check_failed'. SCIM client shows 400 Bad Request with body 'invalid assertion'.

paula: that padding error usually means RSA-PSS vs PKCS#1 v1.5 mismatch. Did someone change the signing algorithm on the IdP?

devops-bot: automated: kms: rotated key alias projects/redwood/keys/idp-signing-key at 2026-03-21T03:05:12Z (version: v7). No IAM changes reported.

security-oncall: impact P2: user logins failing and provisioning degrading. Repro steps?

ajmal: grabbed raw SAML from the login attempt: `<ds:SignatureMethod Algorithm="http://www.w3.org/2007/05/xmldsig-more#rsa-pss"/>` — that's PS-SHA256. Our verifier only accepts rsa-sha256 (RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5).

alexa: Okta tenant acme-corp had IdP cert refresh this morning per their dashboard. Possible they defaulted to PSS.

okta-sre: confirming — Okta rotated certs for multiple orgs. Some app configurations set to 'auto' will prefer PSS when available. We're double-checking which tenants flipped.

paula: mitigation options: 1) ask Okta to switch that tenant's app to force RS256, 2) update our verifier to accept PS256 (PSS) with strict parameter enforcement, 3) temporary SCIM fallback (manual token) for provisioning. Which is quickest?

ajmal: option 2 is fastest end-to-end for all customers long-term. I can add support in verifier behind a feature flag and do a canary. Low level change: add PS256 branch to signature verification and explicit pss params: `rsa_padding_mode=pss`, `mgf1md=sha256`.

alexa: we must also emit audit fields so we can see which IdPs are using PS and correlate with SCIM failures. Add `idp_sig_alg` to our auth audit events.

paula: and we should log the KMS rotation id+time in the incident notes for compliance. Security needs that mapping.

security-oncall: agreed. Opened incident PD-INC-2026-189. Tagging compliance.

devops-bot: deploy note: pipeline queued for `auth-proxy/feat/pss-verify` (CI passed). Manual canary approval required.

ajmal: PR link: https://git.internal/reviews/2274 — adds PS256 verification guarded by env var `AUTH_ACCEPT_PSS`. Canary plan: route 5% of auth traffic to `auth-canary-pss` for 2 hours.

alexa: paula, can you draft customer comms? short note: "We observed IdP signing algorithm changes after certificate refresh; deploying compatibility fix; no customer keys compromised."

paula: on it. Also preparing rollback steps: flip env var off and drain canary pool.

okta-sre: update: acme-corp app was set to auto; tenant ops can flip it back to rsa-sha256 if they want immediate fix. We'll await their direction.

ajmal: verification snippet I used during dev: `gcloud kms keys versions get-public-key 7 --key=idp-signing-key --out=pub.pem` then `openssl pkeyutl -verify -in sig.bin -inkey pub.pem -sigopt rsa_padding_mode:pss -pkeyopt digest:sha256` — succeeds for the failing assertion.

alexa: good evidence. Who's owning roll?

ajmal: I'll own the PR + canary. ETA patch merged today, canary tonight, prod deploy tomorrow 09:00 UTC if canary stable.

paula: I'll add the audit field and run a backfill for last 48h after canary. Script: `scripts/backfill_idp_alg.sh --since 2026-03-19T00:00Z --out acme-alg-backfill.csv`.

security-oncall: risk note: accepting PS256 is acceptable (PSS is stronger) but we must be explicit in verifier choices to avoid parameter ambiguity. Ensure we don't accept degraded MGF/digest combos.

ajmal: code sets `mgf1md=sha256` and rejects any mismatch. Also mapping logic only marks tenants as PSS-allowed after successful verification in staging.

devops-bot: canary started: auth-canary-pss receiving 5% traffic at 2026-03-21T21:00:00Z.

alexa: monitoring: login error rate for acme-corp dropped from ~12% to 0.6% in canary. SCIM 400s reduced accordingly.

paula: backfill run scheduled at 23:30 UTC, will attach CSV to PD incident.

okta-sre: tenant ops confirms auto-rotation caused switch to PSS for some customers. We'll add a doc update recommending explicit alg selection in app settings.

security-oncall: update incident notes with KMS rotation: key version v7 and time 2026-03-21T03:05:12Z. Marking compliance action required.

ajmal: canary healthy after 2h. Rolling out feature flag to 40% at 23:15, full rollout slated 03:00 UTC.

alexa: thanks team. Once full rollout completes, follow up with customers and close PD incident. :thumbsup:
